cases.name: a call to an Orkeon MCP tool is logged: one tab-separated line - the UTC time, the session, `main` on the main chain, the tool without its mcp__orkeon__ prefix - and nothing of its arguments; the hook prints nothing and exits 0
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/on-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$w"; log="$w/.claude/local/mcp-calls.tsv"; p='{"hook_event_name": "PreToolUse", "session_id": "{{SID}}", "tool_name": "mcp__orkeon__grep", "tool_input": {"path": "/secret/place.txt", "pattern": "PRIVATE-TEXT"}}'; out=$(printf '%s' "$p" | env -u HARNESS_MCP_LOG ORKEON_WORKSHOP="$w" bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/mcp-log.sh 2>&1); rc=$?; grep -qE 'secret|PRIVATE|pattern|tool_input' "$log" && printf 'LEAK '; awk -F'\t' -v rc="$rc" -v o="${#out}" '{ printf "rc=%s out=%s n=%d f=%d ts=%s sid=%s agent=%s tool=%s", rc, o, NR, NF, ($1 ~ /^[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]T[0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9]Z$/ ? "ok" : $1), ($2 == "{{SID}}" ? "ok" : $2), $3, $4 }' "$log"

expect.stdout: rc=0 out=0 n=1 f=4 ts=ok sid=ok agent=main tool=grep

cases.name: inside a subagent the third field is the agent type, and a second call appends a second line
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/agent-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$w"; log="$w/.claude/local/mcp-calls.tsv"; for t in read_file code_search; do printf '%s' '{"hook_event_name": "PreToolUse", "session_id": "{{SID}}", "agent_id": "a1b2", "agent_type": "team-builder", "tool_name": "mcp__orkeon__'"$t"'", "tool_input": {"path": "/x"}}' | ORKEON_WORKSHOP="$w" HARNESS_MCP_LOG=1 bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/mcp-log.sh; done; printf 'n=%s ' "$(wc -l < "$log" | tr -d ' ')"; cut -f3,4 "$log" | tr '\t\n' ':,'

cases.name: another tool - Claude Code's own, or another MCP server's - is not logged
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/other-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$w"; log="$w/.claude/local/mcp-calls.tsv"; o=''; for t in Bash Read mcp__github__grep mcp__orkeon__ mcp__orkeonx__grep; do o=$o$(printf '%s' '{"hook_event_name": "PreToolUse", "session_id": "{{SID}}", "tool_name": "'"$t"'", "tool_input": {}}' | ORKEON_WORKSHOP="$w" bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/mcp-log.sh 2>&1; printf 'rc=%s ' $?); done; [ -e "$log" ] && l=present || l=absent; printf '%slog=%s' "$o" "$l"

expect.stdout: rc=0 rc=0 rc=0 rc=0 rc=0 log=absent

cases.name: HARNESS_MCP_LOG=0: nothing is logged, nothing printed
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/off-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$w"; log="$w/.claude/local/mcp-calls.tsv"; p='{"hook_event_name": "PreToolUse", "session_id": "{{SID}}", "tool_name": "mcp__orkeon__grep", "tool_input": {"path": "/secret/place.txt", "pattern": "PRIVATE-TEXT"}}'; out=$(printf '%s' "$p" | env HARNESS_MCP_LOG=0 ORKEON_WORKSHOP="$w" bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/mcp-log.sh 2>&1); rc=$?; [ -e "$log" ] && l=present || l=absent; printf 'rc=%s out=%s log=%s' "$rc" "${#out}" "$l"

cases.name: it never blocks and never prints: an empty payload, a payload that is not JSON, a folder that cannot be written, a log that is a symbolic link or a folder - exit 0, no output, nothing written through the link
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/fail-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$w/a/.claude/local" "$w/b/.claude/local/mcp-calls.tsv" "$w/c"; : > "$w/target"; ln -s "$w/target" "$w/a/.claude/local/mcp-calls.tsv"; : > "$w/c/.claude"; p='{"hook_event_name": "PreToolUse", "session_id": "{{SID}}", "tool_name": "mcp__orkeon__grep", "tool_input": {"path": "/secret/place.txt", "pattern": "PRIVATE-TEXT"}}'; o=''; for d in a b c; do o=$o$(printf '%s' "$p" | ORKEON_WORKSHOP="$w/$d" bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/mcp-log.sh 2>&1; printf 'rc=%s ' $?); done; o=$o$(printf '' | ORKEON_WORKSHOP="$w/a" bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/mcp-log.sh 2>&1; printf 'rc=%s ' $?); o=$o$(printf 'not json' | ORKEON_WORKSHOP="$w/a" bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/mcp-log.sh 2>&1; printf 'rc=%s ' $?); printf '%starget=%s' "$o" "$(wc -c < "$w/target" | tr -d ' ')"

expect.stdout: rc=0 rc=0 rc=0 rc=0 rc=0 target=0

cases.name: through the launcher, as settings.json registers it: matcher mcp__orkeon__.* on PreToolUse, the switch on by default, and the logged line is the same
cases.cmd: s={{CLAUDE}}/settings.json; printf 'matcher=%s switch=%s ' "$(jq -r '.hooks.PreToolUse[] | select(.hooks[].command | endswith("hook-run.sh\" mcp-log")) | .matcher' "$s")" "$(jq -r .env.HARNESS_MCP_LOG "$s")"; w={{FIX}}/run-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$w"; p='{"hook_event_name": "PreToolUse", "session_id": "{{SID}}", "tool_name": "mcp__orkeon__list_files", "tool_input": {"path": "/secret/place.txt", "pattern": "PRIVATE-TEXT"}}'; out=$(printf '%s' "$p" | env -u HARNESS_HOOKS_DIR ORKEON_WORKSHOP="$w" bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/hook-run.sh mcp-log 2>&1); printf 'rc=%s out=%s tool=%s' $? "${#out}" "$(cut -f4 "$w/.claude/local/mcp-calls.tsv")"
